## Service: chat-widget (Chat Widget API)

Documentation for Chat Widget API

### Clone a Chat Widget
POST /chat-widget/clone
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/clone
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/clone-chat-widget | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/clone-chat-widget.md

Clones an existing chat widget into a new widget

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CloneChatWidgetDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "oHJiAh0wDG3BzmzACVD6") - locationId
- chatWidgetId* string (e.g. "oHJiAh0wDG3BzmzACVD6") - ID of the widget to clone. Cloning is rejected with a 422 when the source widget’s stored chatType is outside liveChat and emailChat — the restriction is evaluated against the persisted widget, not against this request body.
- name string (e.g. "Chat Widget 1 (copy)") - Name for the cloned widget

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- _id* string - Chat widget ID
- version* number - Schema version of the widget
- chatType* string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat) - Chat Type. Reads are not restricted to the public-API write allow-list, so any stored chat type can be returned here.
- name* string - Widget name
- locationId* string - The location ID that owns this widget
- deleted* boolean - Whether the widget is soft-deleted
- default* boolean - Whether this is the default widget for the location
- settings object - Widget settings
  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - placeholderColor string - Placeholder color
    - liveChatIcon string | string - Live-chat acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - liveChatPlaceholderColor string - Placeholder color for live chat
  - agencyName string - Name of the agency
  - agencyWebsite string - Website URL of the agency
  - allowAvatarImage boolean - Allow avatar image
  - autoCountryCode boolean - Boolean indicating whether to automatically detect country code
  - countryCode string - Country code
  - chatType string (enum: liveChat | emailChat) - Chat Type. The public API supports only liveChat and emailChat; any other value is rejected with a 422.
  - promptType string (enum: avatar | normal) - Chat bubble style — "avatar" shows the agent avatar, "normal" shows a plain bubble.
  - chatIcon string | string - Icon shown on the closed chat bubble. Either a preset name (`messageChatCircle`, `messageChatSquare`, `messageSquare`, `messageDotsCircle`, `messageWhatsApp`, `phoneCall01`, `phone`, `phoneOutgoing02`, `fbMessenger`, `instagram`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
    - option 1: string
    - option 2: string
  - enableRevisitMessage boolean - Boolean indicating whether to enable a revisit message
  - heading string - Heading text
  - legalMsg string - Legal message
  - liveChatAckMsg string - Message acknowledging a live chat
  - liveChatEndedMsg string - Message indicating the end of a live chat
  - liveChatFeedbackMsg string - Message asking for feedback after a live chat
  - liveChatFeedbackNote string - Note regarding live chat feedback
  - liveChatIntroMsg string - Introduction message for a live chat
  - liveChatUserInactiveMsg string - Message for inactive users during a live chat
  - liveChatUserInactiveTime string - Time for considering a user inactive during a live chat
  - liveChatVisitorInactiveMsg string - Message for inactive visitors during a live chat
  - liveChatVisitorInactiveTime string - Time for considering a visitor inactive during a live chat
  - locale string (enum: location | auto | en-us | en-gb | de | fr-fr | nl | hu | pt-pt | pt-br | es | fr-ca | hr | it | sv-se | da-dk | fi | no) - Locale setting. Use "location" to inherit from the location's locale, or "auto" to detect from the visitor's browser. Otherwise pick a BCP 47 tag in hyphen-lowercase form.
  - promptAvatar string - Avatar for prompts
  - promptAvatarAltText string - Prompt Avatar Alt Text
  - isPromptAvatarImageOptimize boolean - Avatar Image Optimization
  - promptMsg string - Prompt message
  - revisitPromptMsg string - Message for revisiting prompts
  - sendActionText string - Text for send action

    - value string - Resolved theme value / preset identifier persisted alongside the preset name.

  - waNumber string - WhatsApp number

    - sizes object - Widget dimensions (width/height)
      - width number | string - Width in pixels. Accepts a number (360), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number

      - height number | string - Height in pixels. Accepts a number (640), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string
  - advanceSettings object - Advance Settings
    - brandingTitle string - Branding Title
    - redirect object - Redirect Object
      - redirectAction boolean - Redirect Action
      - redirectWebsite string - Redirect Website
      - redirectText string - Redirect Text
    - enableContactForm boolean - Boolean for showing contact form at start
    - defaultConsentCheck boolean - By default consent check for contact form
    - businessOfficeHours object - Business Office Hours
      - enableBusinessHours boolean - Enable Business Hours
      - openHours object[] - Open Hours
        - daysOfTheWeek string[] - Day of week
        - hours string[] - Hours
      - timezone string - Time Zone
      - outsideOfficeHoursWelcomeMsg string - Time Zone
    - contactFormOptions object[] - Ordered list of fields shown on the chat-widget contact form. Standard fields are identified by `value` = `name | phone | email | message`; custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - label string - Display label shown next to the field in the form.
      - value string - Field identifier. For standard fields use one of: `name`, `phone`, `email`, `message`. For custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | TEXTAREA | EMAIL | PHONE | DATE | NUMERICAL | MONETORY | SINGLE_OPTIONS) - Data type of the field, used to pick the input control and validation.
      - placeholder string - Placeholder text rendered inside the input.
      - fieldKey string - Dotted field key used to write the value onto the contact (e.g. `contact.email`).
      - required boolean - Whether the field must be filled in to submit the form.
      - id string - Client-assigned field identifier; the chat-widget UI round-trips this on save.
      - disabled boolean - Whether the field is shown but disabled in the form editor.
      - picklistOptions string[] - Choices for option-type custom fields (SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX).
    - allInOneChatTypes string[] - All In One Chat Type
    - allInOneInitialMsg string - All In One Initial Msg
    - contactFormIntroMessage string - Contact Form Intro Message
    - contactFormSystemMessage string - Contact Form System Message
    - prefilledMessageText string - Prefilled Message Text
    - voiceAiAgent object - Voice AI Agent
    - fbPage object - Facebook Page
      - facebookPageId string - Facebook Page ID
      - facebookPageName string - Facebook Page Name
    - instagramPage object - Instagram Page
      - facebookPageId string - Facebook Page ID
      - facebookPageName string - Facebook Page Name
      - instagramPageId string - Instagram Page ID
      - instagramUsername string - Instagram UserName
    - playNotificationSound boolean - Play Notification Sound
    - allowVoiceNotes boolean - Allow visitors to record and send voice notes from the chat window
    - allowAttachments boolean - Allow visitors to send attachments (images, PDFs, files) alongside their messages
    - voiceAiSendActionText string - Voice Ai Send Action Text
    - voiceAiDisplayMode string (enum: avatar | visualiser) - Voice AI display mode
    - voiceAiAnimation string (enum: 1) - Voice AI Animation ID. Only "1" is supported for now.
    - voiceAiAnimationColor string - Voice AI animation visualiser color
    - voiceAiAnimationSize string (enum: sm | md | lg) - Voice AI animation size for the embedded visualiser orb
    - addSupportingText boolean - Add Supporting Text
    - supportingText string - Supporting Text
  - locationCountryCode string - Location Country Code
  - widgetPlacement string (enum: sticky | embedded) - Widget Placement. "sticky" keeps the widget pinned to a page corner; "embedded" renders inline within the host page.
  - loadStrategy string (enum: immediate | interaction) - Load strategy for the embed script: "immediate" loads on page load (default), "interaction" defers until user interacts.
- creationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot) - How the widget was created
- updatedBy string - ID of the user who last updated the widget
- originId string - ID of the widget this one was cloned or imported from
- createdAt* string - Creation timestamp (ISO 8601)
- updatedAt* string - Last update timestamp (ISO 8601)

### List Chat Widgets
GET /chat-widget/list
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/list
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/list-chat-widgets | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/list-chat-widgets.md

Retrieves a list of chat widgets for a specific location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The location ID
- offset* string (e.g. "0") - Row offset. Defaults to 0, capped at 10000.
- limit* string (e.g. "10") - Page size. Must be greater than 0, capped at 100.
- chatType string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat | webChat; e.g. "emailChat") - The type of chat widget. Supports normal ChatType values, plus the virtual umbrella "webChat" (maps to facebookChat/emailChat/instagramChat/waChat).
- excludeChatType string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat; e.g. "voiceAiChat") - The type of chat widget
- voiceAiAgentId string (e.g. "66597c9a41106ba6eb4eac3c") - The voice AI agent ID
- creationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot; e.g. "chat-widget") - The source that created the widget
- excludeCreationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot; e.g. "a2pCompliance") - Exclude widgets with this creation source

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- chatWidgets* object[] - Matching chat widgets for this page
  - _id* string - Chat widget ID
  - name* string - Widget name
  - chatType* string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat) - Chat Type. Reads are not restricted to the public-API write allow-list, so any stored chat type can be returned here.
  - default* boolean - Whether this is the default widget for the location
  - creationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot) - How the widget was created
  - settings object - Projected subset of settings returned for list rows
  - createdAt* string - Creation timestamp (ISO 8601)
  - updatedAt* string - Last update timestamp (ISO 8601)
- totalCount* number - Total widgets matching the filters, ignoring limit and offset

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)

### Patch Chat Widget
PATCH /chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/patch-chat-widget | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/patch-chat-widget.md

Applies a partial update to an existing chat widget

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- id* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The chat widget ID
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The location ID

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateWidgetDTO:
- version number (e.g. 2) - Version
- chatType string (enum: liveChat | emailChat; e.g. "emailChat") - Chat Type. The public API supports only liveChat and emailChat; any other value is rejected with a 422.
- name string (e.g. "Chat Widget 1") - Name
- default boolean - Default
- settings object - Settings
  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string (e.g. "Check") - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - placeholderColor string (e.g. "#000") - Placeholder color
    - liveChatIcon string | string (e.g. "Check") - Live-chat acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - liveChatPlaceholderColor string (e.g. "#000") - Placeholder color for live chat
  - agencyName string (e.g. "Example Agency") - Name of the agency
  - agencyWebsite string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Website URL of the agency
  - allowAvatarImage boolean - Allow avatar image
  - autoCountryCode boolean - Boolean indicating whether to automatically detect country code
  - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Country code
  - chatType string (enum: liveChat | emailChat; e.g. "emailChat") - Chat Type. The public API supports only liveChat and emailChat; any other value is rejected with a 422.
  - promptType string (enum: avatar | normal; e.g. "avatar") - Chat bubble style — "avatar" shows the agent avatar, "normal" shows a plain bubble.
  - chatIcon string | string (e.g. "messageChatCircle") - Icon shown on the closed chat bubble. Either a preset name (`messageChatCircle`, `messageChatSquare`, `messageSquare`, `messageDotsCircle`, `messageWhatsApp`, `phoneCall01`, `phone`, `phoneOutgoing02`, `fbMessenger`, `instagram`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
    - option 1: string
    - option 2: string
  - enableRevisitMessage boolean - Boolean indicating whether to enable a revisit message
  - heading string (e.g. "Welcome to Our Website") - Heading text
  - legalMsg string (e.g. "By using this website, you agree to our terms and conditions.") - Legal message
  - liveChatAckMsg string (e.g. "Thank you for reaching out. How may I assist you today?") - Message acknowledging a live chat
  - liveChatEndedMsg string (e.g. "Thank you for chatting with us. Have a great day!") - Message indicating the end of a live chat
  - liveChatFeedbackMsg string (e.g. "We would appreciate your feedback. Please rate your experience.") - Message asking for feedback after a live chat
  - liveChatFeedbackNote string (e.g. "Your feedback helps us improve our services.") - Note regarding live chat feedback
  - liveChatIntroMsg string (e.g. "Hello! Welcome to our live chat support. How can I assist you today?") - Introduction message for a live chat
  - liveChatUserInactiveMsg string (e.g. "Are you still there? Please let us know if you need assistance.") - Message for inactive users during a live chat
  - liveChatUserInactiveTime string (e.g. "5 minutes") - Time for considering a user inactive during a live chat
  - liveChatVisitorInactiveMsg string (e.g. "Looks like you stepped away. Feel free to return whenever you need help.") - Message for inactive visitors during a live chat
  - liveChatVisitorInactiveTime string (e.g. "10 minutes") - Time for considering a visitor inactive during a live chat
  - locale string (enum: location | auto | en-us | en-gb | de | fr-fr | nl | hu | pt-pt | pt-br | es | fr-ca | hr | it | sv-se | da-dk | fi | no; e.g. "en-us") - Locale setting. Use "location" to inherit from the location's locale, or "auto" to detect from the visitor's browser. Otherwise pick a BCP 47 tag in hyphen-lowercase form.
  - promptAvatar string (e.g. "avatar.jpg") - Avatar for prompts
  - promptAvatarAltText string (e.g. "company logo") - Prompt Avatar Alt Text
  - isPromptAvatarImageOptimize boolean - Avatar Image Optimization
  - promptMsg string (e.g. "Need assistance? Feel free to ask us anything!") - Prompt message
  - revisitPromptMsg string (e.g. "Welcome back! How can we help you today?") - Message for revisiting prompts
  - sendActionText string (e.g. "Send") - Text for send action
  - showAgencyBranding boolean - Boolean indicating whether to show agency branding
  - showConsentCheckbox boolean - Boolean indicating whether to show a consent checkbox
  - showLiveChatWelcomeMsg boolean - Boolean indicating whether to show a welcome message for live chat
  - showPrompt boolean - Boolean indicating whether to show prompts
  - subHeading string (e.g. "We are here to help you!") - Subheading text
  - successMsg string (e.g. "Your message has been sent successfully.") - Success message
  - supportContact string (e.g. "support@example.com") - Contact information for support
  - thankYouMsg string (e.g. "Thank you for visiting our website!") - Thank you message
  - theme object - Theme
    - name string (enum: blue | teal | tan | lavender | golden | instagram | facebook | custom; e.g. "blue") - Theme preset name. Use "custom" together with a colors/typography object to override.
    - value string (e.g. "blue") - Resolved theme value / preset identifier persisted alongside the preset name.
    - colors object - Custom Color Options
      - chatBubbleColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Chat Bubble Color
      - backgroundColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Background Color
      - headerColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Header Color
      - buttonColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Button Color
      - avatarBackgroundColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Avatar Background Color
      - avatarBorderColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Avatar Border Color
      - senderMessageColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Sender Message Color
      - receivedMessageColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Received Message Color
    - typography object - Typography Options
      - fontFamily string (e.g. "inter") - Font Family
      - colors object - Typography Color Options
        - senderMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Sender Message Text Color
        - receivedMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Received Message Text Color
        - headerMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Header Message Text Color
        - welcomeMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Welcome Message Text Color
        - systemMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - System Message Text Color
  - waNumber string (e.g. "+1234567890") - WhatsApp number
  - widgetPrimaryColor string (e.g. "#4285F4") - Primary color for the widget
  - representativeAssignedMessage string (e.g. "#4285F4") - Representative Assigned Message
  - dimensions object - Customizations
    - position string (enum: top-left | top-right | middle-left | middle-right | bottom-left | bottom-right; e.g. "bottom-right") - Widget anchor position on the host page (kebab-case).
    - sizes object - Widget dimensions (width/height)
      - width number | string (e.g. 360) - Width in pixels. Accepts a number (360), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string
      - height number | string (e.g. 640) - Height in pixels. Accepts a number (640), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string
  - advanceSettings object - Advance Settings
    - brandingTitle string (e.g. "Agency") - Branding Title
    - redirect object - Redirect Object
      - redirectAction boolean - Redirect Action
      - redirectWebsite string (e.g. "www.example.com") - Redirect Website
      - redirectText string (e.g. "Click here") - Redirect Text
    - enableContactForm boolean - Boolean for showing contact form at start
    - defaultConsentCheck boolean - By default consent check for contact form
    - businessOfficeHours object - Business Office Hours
      - enableBusinessHours boolean - Enable Business Hours
      - openHours object[] - Open Hours
        - daysOfTheWeek string[] (e.g. [1]) - Day of week
        - hours string[] - Hours
      - timezone string (e.g. "UTC") - Time Zone
      - outsideOfficeHoursWelcomeMsg string (e.g. "Asia/Calcutta") - Time Zone
    - contactFormOptions object[] - Ordered list of fields shown on the chat-widget contact form. Standard fields are identified by `value` = `name | phone | email | message`; custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - label string (e.g. "Email") - Display label shown next to the field in the form.
      - value string (e.g. "email") - Field identifier. For standard fields use one of: `name`, `phone`, `email`, `message`. For custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | TEXTAREA | EMAIL | PHONE | DATE | NUMERICAL | MONETORY | SINGLE_OPTIONS; e.g. "EMAIL") - Data type of the field, used to pick the input control and validation.
      - placeholder string (e.g. "Email") - Placeholder text rendered inside the input.
      - fieldKey string (e.g. "contact.email") - Dotted field key used to write the value onto the contact (e.g. `contact.email`).
      - required boolean - Whether the field must be filled in to submit the form.
      - id string (e.g. "1") - Client-assigned field identifier; the chat-widget UI round-trips this on save.
      - disabled boolean - Whether the field is shown but disabled in the form editor.
      - picklistOptions string[] (e.g. ["Option 1","Option 2"]) - Choices for option-type custom fields (SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX).
    - allInOneChatTypes string[] (e.g. []) - All In One Chat Type
    - allInOneInitialMsg string (e.g. "Choose a chat option to get started.") - All In One Initial Msg
    - contactFormIntroMessage string (e.g. "Please share contact details") - Contact Form Intro Message
    - contactFormSystemMessage string (e.g. "Please share contact details") - Contact Form System Message
    - prefilledMessageText string (e.g. "I want to know more") - Prefilled Message Text
    - voiceAiAgent object - Voice AI Agent
    - fbPage object - Facebook Page
      - facebookPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Facebook Page ID
      - facebookPageName string (e.g. "Facebook Page Name") - Facebook Page Name
    - instagramPage object - Instagram Page
      - facebookPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Facebook Page ID
      - facebookPageName string (e.g. "Facebook Page Name") - Facebook Page Name
      - instagramPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Instagram Page ID
      - instagramUsername string (e.g. "Instagram UserName") - Instagram UserName
    - playNotificationSound boolean - Play Notification Sound
    - allowVoiceNotes boolean - Allow visitors to record and send voice notes from the chat window
    - allowAttachments boolean - Allow visitors to send attachments (images, PDFs, files) alongside their messages
    - voiceAiSendActionText string (e.g. "Call Now") - Voice Ai Send Action Text
    - voiceAiDisplayMode string (enum: avatar | visualiser; e.g. "avatar") - Voice AI display mode
    - voiceAiAnimation string (enum: 1; e.g. "1") - Voice AI Animation ID. Only "1" is supported for now.
    - voiceAiAnimationColor string (e.g. "#155EEF") - Voice AI animation visualiser color
    - voiceAiAnimationSize string (enum: sm | md | lg; e.g. "md") - Voice AI animation size for the embedded visualiser orb
    - addSupportingText boolean - Add Supporting Text
    - supportingText string (e.g. "We are here to help you") - Supporting Text
  - locationCountryCode string (e.g. "US") - Location Country Code
  - widgetPlacement string (enum: sticky | embedded; e.g. "embedded") - Widget Placement. "sticky" keeps the widget pinned to a page corner; "embedded" renders inline within the host page.
  - loadStrategy string (enum: immediate | interaction; e.g. "interaction") - Load strategy for the embed script: "immediate" loads on page load (default), "interaction" defers until user interacts.

- name* string - Widget name
- locationId* string - The location ID that owns this widget
- deleted* boolean - Whether the widget is soft-deleted
- default* boolean - Whether this is the default widget for the location

  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.

    - liveChatIcon string | string - Live-chat acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string

### Update Chat Widget
PUT /chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/update-chat-widget | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/update-chat-widget.md

Replaces an existing chat widget with the provided configuration

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.write

    - name string (enum: blue | teal | tan | lavender | golden | instagram | facebook | custom; e.g. "blue") - Theme preset name. Use "custom" together with a colors/typography object to override.
    - value string (e.g. "blue") - Resolved theme value / preset identifier persisted alongside the preset name.
    - colors object - Custom Color Options
      - chatBubbleColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Chat Bubble Color
      - backgroundColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Background Color
      - headerColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Header Color
      - buttonColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Button Color
      - avatarBackgroundColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Avatar Background Color
      - avatarBorderColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Avatar Border Color
      - senderMessageColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Sender Message Color
      - receivedMessageColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Received Message Color
    - typography object - Typography Options
      - fontFamily string (e.g. "inter") - Font Family
      - colors object - Typography Color Options
        - senderMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Sender Message Text Color
        - receivedMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Received Message Text Color
        - headerMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Header Message Text Color
        - welcomeMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Welcome Message Text Color
        - systemMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - System Message Text Color
  - waNumber string (e.g. "+1234567890") - WhatsApp number
  - widgetPrimaryColor string (e.g. "#4285F4") - Primary color for the widget
  - representativeAssignedMessage string (e.g. "#4285F4") - Representative Assigned Message
  - dimensions object - Customizations
    - position string (enum: top-left | top-right | middle-left | middle-right | bottom-left | bottom-right; e.g. "bottom-right") - Widget anchor position on the host page (kebab-case).
    - sizes object - Widget dimensions (width/height)
      - width number | string (e.g. 360) - Width in pixels. Accepts a number (360), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string
      - height number | string (e.g. 640) - Height in pixels. Accepts a number (640), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string
  - advanceSettings object - Advance Settings
    - brandingTitle string (e.g. "Agency") - Branding Title
    - redirect object - Redirect Object
      - redirectAction boolean - Redirect Action
      - redirectWebsite string (e.g. "www.example.com") - Redirect Website
      - redirectText string (e.g. "Click here") - Redirect Text
    - enableContactForm boolean - Boolean for showing contact form at start
    - defaultConsentCheck boolean - By default consent check for contact form
    - businessOfficeHours object - Business Office Hours
      - enableBusinessHours boolean - Enable Business Hours
      - openHours object[] - Open Hours
        - daysOfTheWeek string[] (e.g. [1]) - Day of week
        - hours string[] - Hours
      - timezone string (e.g. "UTC") - Time Zone
      - outsideOfficeHoursWelcomeMsg string (e.g. "Asia/Calcutta") - Time Zone
    - contactFormOptions object[] - Ordered list of fields shown on the chat-widget contact form. Standard fields are identified by `value` = `name | phone | email | message`; custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - label string (e.g. "Email") - Display label shown next to the field in the form.
      - value string (e.g. "email") - Field identifier. For standard fields use one of: `name`, `phone`, `email`, `message`. For custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | TEXTAREA | EMAIL | PHONE | DATE | NUMERICAL | MONETORY | SINGLE_OPTIONS; e.g. "EMAIL") - Data type of the field, used to pick the input control and validation.
      - placeholder string (e.g. "Email") - Placeholder text rendered inside the input.
      - fieldKey string (e.g. "contact.email") - Dotted field key used to write the value onto the contact (e.g. `contact.email`).
      - required boolean - Whether the field must be filled in to submit the form.
      - id string (e.g. "1") - Client-assigned field identifier; the chat-widget UI round-trips this on save.
      - disabled boolean - Whether the field is shown but disabled in the form editor.
      - picklistOptions string[] (e.g. ["Option 1","Option 2"]) - Choices for option-type custom fields (SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX).
    - allInOneChatTypes string[] (e.g. []) - All In One Chat Type
    - allInOneInitialMsg string (e.g. "Choose a chat option to get started.") - All In One Initial Msg
    - contactFormIntroMessage string (e.g. "Please share contact details") - Contact Form Intro Message
    - contactFormSystemMessage string (e.g. "Please share contact details") - Contact Form System Message
    - prefilledMessageText string (e.g. "I want to know more") - Prefilled Message Text
    - voiceAiAgent object - Voice AI Agent
    - fbPage object - Facebook Page
      - facebookPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Facebook Page ID
      - facebookPageName string (e.g. "Facebook Page Name") - Facebook Page Name
    - instagramPage object - Instagram Page
      - facebookPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Facebook Page ID
      - facebookPageName string (e.g. "Facebook Page Name") - Facebook Page Name
      - instagramPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Instagram Page ID
      - instagramUsername string (e.g. "Instagram UserName") - Instagram UserName
    - playNotificationSound boolean - Play Notification Sound
    - allowVoiceNotes boolean - Allow visitors to record and send voice notes from the chat window
    - allowAttachments boolean - Allow visitors to send attachments (images, PDFs, files) alongside their messages
    - voiceAiSendActionText string (e.g. "Call Now") - Voice Ai Send Action Text
    - voiceAiDisplayMode string (enum: avatar | visualiser; e.g. "avatar") - Voice AI display mode
    - voiceAiAnimation string (enum: 1; e.g. "1") - Voice AI Animation ID. Only "1" is supported for now.
    - voiceAiAnimationColor string (e.g. "#155EEF") - Voice AI animation visualiser color
    - voiceAiAnimationSize string (enum: sm | md | lg; e.g. "md") - Voice AI animation size for the embedded visualiser orb
    - addSupportingText boolean - Add Supporting Text
    - supportingText string (e.g. "We are here to help you") - Supporting Text
  - locationCountryCode string (e.g. "US") - Location Country Code
  - widgetPlacement string (enum: sticky | embedded; e.g. "embedded") - Widget Placement. "sticky" keeps the widget pinned to a page corner; "embedded" renders inline within the host page.
  - loadStrategy string (enum: immediate | interaction; e.g. "interaction") - Load strategy for the embed script: "immediate" loads on page load (default), "interaction" defers until user interacts.

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- _id* string - Chat widget ID
- version* number - Schema version of the widget
- chatType* string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat) - Chat Type. Reads are not restricted to the public-API write allow-list, so any stored chat type can be returned here.
- name* string - Widget name
- locationId* string - The location ID that owns this widget
- deleted* boolean - Whether the widget is soft-deleted
- default* boolean - Whether this is the default widget for the location
- settings object - Widget settings
  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - placeholderColor string - Placeholder color
    - liveChatIcon string | string - Live-chat acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - liveChatPlaceholderColor string - Placeholder color for live chat
